name: Cape Jones compositor stack — wired from COLOR-LIGHTING-COMPOSITING-RESEARCH-20261031.md

research_sections_wired.10_hard_and_contact_shadow: wired: hard offset shadow + contact strip darkest at feet
research_sections_wired.1_colour_script_keys: wired: one condition entry per key, with tint multiplier and LUT file
research_sections_wired.2_rim_light: wired: rim layer, dilated alpha minus original, Add
research_sections_wired.3_environment_bleed: wired: bleed layer, edge band only (rim_px to rim_px+5), Screen
research_sections_wired.4_internal_line_lighting: wired: separate light/shadow layers masked to lit side, base untouched
research_sections_wired.5_node_tools: wired: Blender 5.2.3 node tree in blender-compositor-stack.py; PIL script mirrors the same node order and names
research_sections_wired.6_LUT_ACES_delivery: wired in part: .cube trilinear + sRGB JPG delivery. ACES Input/Output transform is NOT implemented in PIL; it requires a colour-managed tool (Blender/Natron/Resolve) and is marked owed, not claimed.
research_sections_wired.8_wet_reflection: wired: flipped duplicate, gradient fade, blur, floor-gated
research_sections_wired.9_fog_aerial: wired: per-plane veiling on background only

rules.bleed_edge_band_only: Bleed = Screen, low opacity, in an outer edge band only (rim_px to rim_px+5). Never a whole-suit tint. Suit stays white.
rules.delivery: Output JPG, sRGB, quality 92. Audio delivery (-14 LUFS) is a separate spec and is NOT faked by this image script.
rules.fog_per_plane: Veiling per depth plane on the BACKGROUND only. Character stays sharp.
rules.god_rays: Painted shafts, Screen/Add ~20%, with gradient falloff along length and soft edges. Not flat cones.
rules.lut: LUT files are 32-point .cube templates, status template/not final approved. apply_compositor.py applies the actual .cube by trilinear interpolation. A LUT changes colour only, no spatial effects.
rules.never_recolour_base_art: Light, shadow, rim and bleed are separate layers composited OVER the untouched rig pixels. The rig layer is copied, never modified in place.
rules.rim_outer_only: Rim = dilated alpha minus original alpha, 2-4 px, Add. No inner outline. Inner outline is DO NOT USE.
rules.shadow_hue: Hard/contact shadow is cool blue-violet, not black. Contact strip is darkest at the feet.
rules.wet_reflection: Flipped duplicate, ~30% wet opacity, gradient fade with distance, progressive blur. Only where a floor plane is present; otherwise skipped honestly.
